G_f.note: Root of the funny-current chain. g_f -> G_f -> G_f_K/G_f_Na -> g_f_K/g_f_Na -> i_fK/i_fNa. g_f_K and g_f_Na are computed variables, not independent constants, so scaling g_f scales the whole current.

G_Ks.note: g_Ks_ is the base constant; g_Ks = 1.2 * g_Ks_ only when Iso > 0. With Iso = 0 they are equal, but g_Ks_ is the correct scaling target.

P_Jup.note: P_up = P_up_basal * (1 - b_up), and b_up = 0 at baseline, so P_up_basal is the correct scaling target.

entries.note: the three parameter mappings that are not inferable from the name

entries.value: No quantity derived from a drug COMBINATION may be used, directly or indirectly, to set or adjust any model parameter. This covers the 12 sampled conductances/fluxes, every drug block fraction, every IC50 or Hill coefficient, every free-concentration assumption, and the retention criteria. Combination outcomes are outputs of this study, never inputs.

For any chronic, steady-state oral regimen, the model is evaluated at the TIME-AVERAGE free concentration over the dosing interval:
    C_avg,free = [ AUC(0-tau) / tau ] * f_unbound
This single value is the primary comparator. Cmax-derived and trough-derived values are computed and reported alongside it as an interval, labelled SENSITIVITY, and are never promoted to primary.

entries.value: The switch INCREASES the unexplained discrepancy against the in vitro IC50 from 61x to 250x. Had gap magnitude been used as a selection criterion the previous 36-month anchor would have been retained. It was not used, and must not be used in future anchor selection: choosing the anchor that flatters the model is the same error as fitting to a pair.
